subject: math
description: Construct triangles and quadrilaterals from angle conditions, then decide whether each construction is possible using angle sums and angle constraints.
learningObjectives: Use the triangle angle sum of 180 degrees to test angle conditions
Use the quadrilateral angle sum of 360 degrees to test angle conditions
Construct or sketch figures that match given angle measures
Explain why a triangle or quadrilateral construction is possible or impossible
Check angle constraints such as positive angle measures and angle sums
prerequisites: Know acute, right, obtuse, and straight angles
